newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Sihanouk heads for medical check up in China.
newsitem.headline: Sihanouk heads for medical check up in China.

text.p: Cambodia's King Norodom Sihanouk left for China on Wednesday for an eye operation and a regular medical check-up, an aide said.
The 74-year-old monarch has managed to beat cancer but suffers from a range of other ailments, including arterio-sclerosis, diabetes and eye problems.
He suffered a stroke last May that briefly paralysed one side of his body.
A senior royal palace official said Sihanouk was going to China for a regular medical check-up. The official expected him to be away for about one month.
The king, who looked well on Wednesday, said earlier this month that he would have surgery to remove a cataract in his right eye.
He had cancelled plans to leave for Beijing on Monday, possibly to avoid his trip coinciding with the funeral service for China's late paramount leader Deng Xiaoping.
